# Umer Khan

> Forward Deployed Engineer at Accenture, based in Berlin, Germany. Takes AI systems from prototype to production and builds products for commerce.
> Source: https://umerkhan.io

## Now

- Forward Deployed Engineer at Accenture since August 2026.
- Maintains shopextract, an open-source (MIT) Python library that extracts structured product data from online stores.

## Experience

- 2026 to present: Accenture, Forward Deployed Engineer. Embedded with enterprise client teams, taking AI systems from prototype to production.
- 2025 to 2026: Bloomers Berlin, Founding Engineer. AI-powered e-commerce systems, GDPR-compliant RAG pipelines, automation workflows.
- 2024: Comparado GmbH (Idealo Group), Data Engineer. ETL standardisation, BI migration to AWS, DSA/DMA compliance.
- 2022 to 2024: CorAI (Bernstein Analytics), Cloud Solutions Architect. A system collecting and classifying 1 million news articles per day.
- 2018 to 2021: Teradata, Data Engineer. Data pipelines for telecom companies including Telenor Pakistan.

Full resume: https://umerkhan.io/cv
